spec_match.rationale: Creates contexts for 'default'/'hardware'/numeric hints and reads renderQuantumSize back, with an automatic on-load probe that correctly reported 'renderQuantumSize not yet exposed' in this browser — the exact spec surface with honest capability detection.

interactive.rationale: Per-hint create-and-inspect buttons plus a numeric input work; CDP click created the context and showed '(not exposed yet)' with real baseLatency/outputLatency readings.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises creating contexts per hint and inspecting the honoured renderQuantumSize including hardware-vs-default differences; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Explicit unsupported branch (red banner with explanation), context-created-but-size-unavailable state, and rounding notes for numeric hints.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5078190552907776 and the spec, plus siblings.

conformance.rationale: Covered by the guarded feature suite (7/7 here), which mirrors this page's acceptance-plus-fallback contract.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Auto-probe banner, button-driven creation, and clean console verified via CDP in Chromium 141; a browser that actually honours the hint could not be observed here.

telemetry_health.rationale: Server-injected /public/demo-telemetry.js verified in the served DOM.

design_system.rationale: Cards and banner use shared variables; the unsupported banner is high-contrast white-on-rose.

accessibility.rationale: One aria-labelled control; result values and the support banner update without live regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-measured clean at 360x740 (scrollWidth 360); desktop verified via screenshot.

openQuestions.title: Refresh version copy against chromestatus
openQuestions.detail: The banner and code comments say 'Chrome 151+', but chromestatus now lists the origin trial as 145–151 with shipping proposed for 153. Update the copy (and mention how to join the OT / enable the feature) so the guidance stays accurate.

openQuestions.title: Announce probe results
openQuestions.detail: Add aria-live=polite to the support banner and result values so the honest capability story is available non-visually.

summary: The model WebAudio page of this feature: exact API, per-hint cards, and an honest auto-probe that correctly declared renderQuantumSize unexposed in this pre-support browser (CDP-verified, clean console, clean 360px layout). Only copy staleness (151 vs 153) and missing live regions hold it back. Browser-verified with headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via CLI (screenshot + DOM dump) and raw CDP (real click dispatch, console/network capture, 360x740 DPR3 mobile emulation) — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud session. Chromium 141 predates Chrome 145, so v145-only API paths were validated on their fallback branches, not the new-API success path. The single failed fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet request is environmental (blocked host) and was not counted against any page.
